action.command: FILE="{{filePath}}"; BANNED=$(grep -nE '(Spring Boot|PostgreSQL|\bRedis\b|\bMongoDB\b|\bNeo4j\b|\bAngular\b|\bKafka\b|\bDrools\b|Java 21|python:3\.|3\.4\.x|version.*[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'Technology Role' | grep -v 'technology-stack' | grep -v 'Glossary' | head -5); if [ -n "$BANNED" ]; then echo "⚠️  AGNOSTIC VIOLATION in $FILE — product names or versions found:"; echo "$BANNED"; echo "Replace with Technology Roles from 01-technology-stack."; fi
